# Toscano Flex Homes

## Business
Toscano Flex Homes is a husband and wife real estate team based in Tri-Cities, Washington State. Laura and Ernesto Toscano are licensed Realtors brokered by Epique Realty (Laura Toscano, WA License #20115070; Ernesto Toscano, WA License #215918). They specialize in buying, selling and investing in residential real estate across Kennewick, Pasco, Richland and all of Washington State.

## Team
- Laura Toscano: Realtor with 6 years of experience. Expert in contracts, deadlines, organization and the administrative side of every transaction. WA License #20115070. Phone: (509) 380-7913
- Ernesto Toscano: Realtor with a background in marketing, sales, television and radio. Focused on communication, negotiation and promoting properties to the right buyers. WA License #215918. Phone: (509) 378-0223

## Services
- Home buying assistance
- Home selling and listing
- Real estate investment guidance
- Property valuation and market analysis
- Bilingual service in English and Spanish

## Service Area
Kennewick WA, Pasco WA, Richland WA, and all of Washington State (Tri-Cities area and beyond).
